biotools.summary: HyperGen is a software tool for genome sketching that utilizes hyperdimensional computing to efficiently estimate Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) for large-scale genome collections. It improves accuracy, runtime performance, and memory efficiency compared to existing methods.
